1 uur geleden

Our chess position evaluations dataset on Hugging Face crossed 1 billion rows! That's over 1,000,000,000 Stockfish evaluations from games played on Lichess, free to download for any purpose.

3 uur geleden

Congratulations to team K2N_chess by FM Konstantin Kostin for winning the 9th ChessMood 20/20 Grand Prix 2026 Qualifier with top scorers GM José Martínez Alcántara, @jiwuna, GM Shant Sargsyan, @dfsocial, FM Vladislav Sipetin, and many others! Thanks to all participating streamers and 1,301 registered players!

43 uur geleden

Get ready for our next Streamer Arenas on 02-11-2026 at 17:00 and 21-12-2026 at 17:00, with prizes for streamers whose teams finish in the top 4! If you're a streamer and want to participate with your team, register now.

46 uur geleden

WGM Sabina Foisor is now live for Round 6 of Lichess4545 Season 50! Tune in to Sabina Foisor's live commentary on Twitch.

2 dagen geleden

Congratulations to GM Oleksandr Bortnyk for winning our Bullet Titled Arena October 2026, ahead of GM Sergei Zhigalko, IM @BrightFalcon, GM Brandon Jacobson, and GM Artem Uskov!

2 dagen geleden

Happy Halloween! Celebrate with us in our 3+0 Halloween Gambit Arena at 23:00.

2 dagen geleden

Our October 1+0 Warm-up Arena starts today, 31-10-2026 at 18:00! Play against some of the titled players before they enter our Bullet Titled Arena at 20:00.
